subject.title: [Bug]: Matrix channel dispatch broken in v2026.6.1 — TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'run')

question: Should the durable fix require pre-import stale official Matrix plugin repair in doctor/update/plugin selection, or is the current update-repair command plus Matrix-local diagnostics enough for this release line?
rationale: The remaining work crosses compatibility and upgrade policy: a durable pre-import repair changes plugin selection/doctor behavior, while accepting diagnostics leaves existing users to recover manually after message loss.

options.title: Require Durable Pre-Import Repair
options.body: Repair or disable stale official Matrix installs before plugin module import, then validate with a packaged npm/docker upgrade repro.

options.title: Accept Recovery-Only Mitigation
options.body: Keep current update-repair guidance and optionally merge Matrix diagnostics, accepting that some users may need manual recovery after upgrade.

options.title: Fold Into Alias Compatibility Work
options.body: Treat this as dependent on the broader runtime compatibility alias discussion and close only after that path proves Matrix recovery too.

recommendation.title: Require Durable Pre-Import Repair
recommendation.body: Repair or disable stale official Matrix installs before plugin module import, then validate with a packaged npm/docker upgrade repro.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent release/update/plugin history makes this the strongest available owner for the upgrade-compatibility decision.
